svg.title: 39. Cat and cow stretch — female orange flat color illustration
svg.desc: Start on your hands and knees. Breathe out and round your back gently. Breathe in and let your chest move forwards as your back forms a small curve.
svg.metadata: Created with built-in image generation using the approved orange female illustration as character and style reference. Converted to curved SVG paths with VTracer. Exercise guide source: https://www.southtees.nhs.uk/services/back-pain/backtracks/kneeling-exercises/
